responses.text: I'm looking forward to getting sent across the river.
The new slave girls are quite beautiful.
Slaves aren't much of a challenge in the arena.
{Benny escaped} That prisoner, Benny, managed to slip away somehow.
{Player defeated Ranger Stella}{missed out on a good arena match} I didn't think anyone could kill an NCR Ranger in single combat.
{Caesar dead} I'll mourn {KAI-zar}Caesar - he was a great man.
{Player killed Lupa} Lupa met an honorable death in the arena.
Some of the slaves have been spreading stories about the Burned Man again.
